text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Office of Barrionuevo broken into and safe with documents taken
- Kabila gives Mobutu eight days to leave Zaire
- 10 secret prisons found in Algeria
EL MUNDO
- "I will not fall into the temptation of calling elections when we enter in the euro" Aznar says in exclusive interview
DIARIO 16
- Eduardo Corrales, plaintiff in Zamora (illegal party financing) case: "Aznar shut up and put up"
- Assault on office of ex-minister Barrionuevo
- The PP purge continues
ABC
- Canary Islands revolts against rise in airfares
CINCO DIAS
- Tax office, more protected than citizen in the tax law; several groups have presented ammendments to invert this situation
- "Sabadell doesn't fix the size for us, it would have to be Argentaria or BCH," Ricardo Lorca, managing director Banco Popular
EXPANSION
- Good economic evolution awakens business optimism

GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Economy consecrates Aznar in his first year of governing
